description: Dependency updates on our own schedule (Chapter 20): Renovate opens no pull requests. It keeps one
issue - the dependency dashboard - listing what is out of date; updates are made by hand, all in one
pull request, after reading the release notes and testing against the version the cluster runs.
Versions outside a standard file carry a '# renovate: datasource=... depName=...' comment above them.
Vulnerability alerts stay with GitHub's own alerts (on for the repository); the workflow token cannot read them.

customManagers.description: Versions pinned in Terraform variables, tfvars, the Makefile and CI workflows, each under a '# renovate:' comment.

packageRules.description: The platform's own images are updated by Flux image automation, not here.
